# 8. Manuscript figures

**Module 08 — Manuscript figures.** Generates the panels of Figure 7, which covers the different PNA analyses of the b1b2 data and the comparison between MPX and PNA. Run the first chunk below to load packages, shared code and the checkpoints saved by modules `01`–`02`. You can open this module in a new R session once those checkpoints exist.

This module:

- loads shared code, palettes and helper functions from `common_setup.R` and the annotated object (`pg_data`) and `markers_to_test` from the checkpoint folder, as in the other modules
- contains Supplement A (MPX/PNA comparison, §8.1) and one section per panel (B–H), each producing one or more exported figures
- saves every panel to `results/08_manuscript_figures/figure7/` (png and pdf, controlled by `options(export_plot.file_formats)` in `common_setup.R`)
- takes results from earlier modules (abundance, proximity, statistical testing) and, for the MPX/PNA comparison, from the MPX analysis in `mpx_2/`

Panel A is not generated here. The panel layout below is a placeholder and will be updated as the figure takes shape.

| Panel | Content | Source |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Supp. A | MPX vs PNA: T cell composition, FMC63+ frequency, protein abundance (counts and shared-protein CLR) | `mpx_2/` results and `pg_data` |
| B | PNA UMAP (annotation, construct, donor, FMC63 abundance) and FMC63 violin by construct | `pg_data` (module `02`) |
| C | Cell annotation proportions per donor, t1-only and paired t0/t1 donors | `pg_data` (module `02`) |
| D | to be defined (t0 axi-cel vs tisa-cel) | to be defined |
| E | to be defined (t1 axi-cel vs tisa-cel) | to be defined |
| F–H | to be defined | to be defined |

```{r}
#| label: module08_setup

library(here)
here::i_am("pna_b1b2/modules/08_manuscript_figures.qmd")

source(here::here("pna_b1b2", "modules", "common_setup.R"))

if (!exists("pg_data", inherits = TRUE)) {
  pg_data <- load_checkpoint("annotated_seurat_object.rds")
}

if (!exists("pg_data_clean", inherits = TRUE)) {
  pg_data_clean <- load_checkpoint("pg_data_platelet_cleaned.rds")
}

# Output folder for all Figure 7 panels
fig7_dir <- here::here(
  "pna_b1b2",
  "results",
  "08_manuscript_figures",
  "figure7"
)
dir.create(fig7_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

png_res <- 300

# Save a panel as fig7_dir/<name>.{png,pdf}
fig7_save <- function(name, plot, width = 5, height = 5) {
  export_plot(
    filename = file.path(fig7_dir, name),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
}
```

**Marker selection.** `markers_to_test` is filtered to markers whose mean CLR is above 0.5 in every sample with at least `min_cells_per_sample` cells of the cell type (`select_markers_by_clr()` in `marker_selection_functions.R`). `FMC63` is always kept.

```{r}
#| label: markers-to-test
if (!exists("markers_to_test", inherits = TRUE)) {
  markers_to_test <- load_checkpoint("markers_to_test.rds")
}

# Updated markers_to_test based on abundance levels: keep markers with a mean CLR
# > clr_cutoff in every sample with >= min_cells_per_sample cells of the cell
# type (restricted to the original markers_to_test)
source(here::here("pna_b1b2", "modules", "marker_selection_functions.R"))

markers_to_test_clr <- select_markers_by_clr(
  pg_data,
  markers_to_test,
  clr_cutoff = 0.5,
  min_cells_per_sample = 15L,
  always_keep = "FMC63"
)

markers_to_test <- markers_to_test_clr
```

## 8.1. Supplement A: MPX/PNA comparison

Comparison of MPX/PNA data for the overlapping samples 

```{r}
# Prepare data: subset to overlapping samples and add metadata column
samples_mpx <- mpx_data@meta.data |>
  pull(sample_alias) |>
  unique() |>
  as.character()
pna_data <- pg_data |> subset(sample_alias %in% samples_mpx)

mpx_data$platform <- "MPX"
pna_data$platform <- "PNA"

mpx_data$cell_annotation <- mpx_data$celltype
```

### 8.1.1. Cell frequency

Compares the final cell labels (`cell_annotation`) between MPX and PNA for the overlapping samples, in two ways:

1. **T cell composition**: the proportion of each labelled T cell population among all labelled T cells of a sample.
2. **FMC63+ frequency within lineage**: the fraction of FMC63+ cells among CD4 T cells and among CD8 T cells (FMC63+ / (FMC63+ + FMC63-)) per sample.

Proportions are computed over the cells that pass each platform's own QC and annotation. The FMC63 status and the lineage are parsed from the labels (e.g. "CD8 T FMC63+"). For the FMC63+ frequency, only samples with at least `min_cells_lineage` CD4 or CD8 T cells on both platforms are shown.

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_a_cell_frequency_data

min_cells_lineage <- 0

cell_meta <- bind_rows(
  mpx_data@meta.data |> select(sample_alias, platform, cell_annotation),
  pna_data@meta.data |> select(sample_alias, platform, cell_annotation)
) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(sample_alias, cell_annotation), as.character),
    # Lineage and FMC63 status parsed from the label, e.g. "CD8 T FMC63+"
    lineage = str_extract(cell_annotation, "^CD[48]"),
    fmc63 = case_when(
      str_detect(cell_annotation, "FMC63\\+$") ~ "FMC63+",
      str_detect(cell_annotation, "FMC63-$") ~ "FMC63-",
      .default = NA_character_
    ),
    is_t_cell = !is.na(lineage) | cell_annotation %in% c("T other", "Other T")
  )

# Labels per platform: check that the naming agrees before comparing
cell_meta |>
  count(cell_annotation, platform) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = platform, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

labels_no_fmc63 <- cell_meta |>
  filter(!is.na(lineage), is.na(fmc63)) |>
  pull(cell_annotation) |>
  unique()
if (length(labels_no_fmc63) > 0) {
  message(
    "CD4/CD8 labels without FMC63 status (excluded from the FMC63+ frequency): ",
    paste(labels_no_fmc63, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

#### T cell composition

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_a_tcell_composition

# Proportion of each T cell label among labelled T cells, per sample and platform
tcell_pct <- cell_meta |>
  filter(is_t_cell) |>
  count(sample_alias, platform, cell_annotation, name = "n_cells") |>
  complete(
    nesting(sample_alias, platform),
    cell_annotation,
    fill = list(n_cells = 0L)
  ) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), .by = c(sample_alias, platform))

readr::write_csv(
  tcell_pct,
  file.path(fig7_dir, "fig7_supp_a_tcell_composition.csv") # Manuscript: Supplementary Figure 8B
)

n_samples_compared <- n_distinct(tcell_pct$sample_alias)

# Stacked bars: MPX and PNA side by side for every sample
p_tcell_composition <- ggplot(
  tcell_pct,
  aes(platform, pct, fill = cell_annotation)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(~sample_alias) + #, switch = "x"
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_palette) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "% of T cells",
    fill = "Cell annotation",
    title = "T cell composition, MPX vs PNA",
    caption = glue::glue(
      "{n_samples_compared} overlapping samples. Proportions among labelled T cells."
    )
  )
p_tcell_composition

fig7_save(
  "fig7_supp_a_tcell_composition",
  p_tcell_composition,
  width = max(6, 0.7 * n_samples_compared + 3),
  height = 5
)

# Agreement between the platforms: one point per sample and T cell label
tcell_wide <- tcell_pct |>
  select(sample_alias, cell_annotation, platform, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = platform, values_from = pct)
tcell_cor <- tcell_wide |>
  summarise(
    pearson = cor(MPX, PNA, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs"),
    spearman = cor(MPX, PNA, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  )

p_tcell_correlation <- ggplot(
  tcell_wide,
  aes(MPX, PNA, fill = cell_annotation)
) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_palette) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "MPX (% of T cells)",
    y = "PNA (% of T cells)",
    color = "Cell annotation",
    title = "T cell composition, MPX vs PNA",
    subtitle = glue::glue(
      "Pearson r = {round(tcell_cor$pearson, 2)}, Spearman rho = {round(tcell_cor$spearman, 2)}"
    ),
    caption = "One point per sample and cell annotation. Dashed line: identity."
  )
p_tcell_correlation
fig7_save(
  "fig7_supp_a_tcell_correlation",
  p_tcell_correlation,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)
```

#### FMC63+ frequency within lineage

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_a_fmc63_frequency

# FMC63+ fraction among CD4 T and among CD8 T cells, per sample and platform
fmc63_freq <- cell_meta |>
  filter(!is.na(lineage), !is.na(fmc63)) |>
  count(sample_alias, platform, lineage, fmc63) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = fmc63, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L)
for (col in c("FMC63+", "FMC63-")) {
  if (!col %in% names(fmc63_freq)) fmc63_freq[[col]] <- 0L
}
fmc63_freq <- fmc63_freq |>
  mutate(
    n_total = `FMC63+` + `FMC63-`,
    pct_fmc63 = 100 * `FMC63+` / n_total
  ) |>
  # Keep sample x lineage combinations with enough cells on both platforms
  mutate(
    enough_cells = all(n_total >= min_cells_lineage) && n() == 2,
    .by = c(sample_alias, lineage)
  )

readr::write_csv(
  fmc63_freq,
  file.path(fig7_dir, "fig7_supp_a_fmc63_frequency.csv")
)

fmc63_freq_plot <- fmc63_freq |>
  filter(enough_cells) |>
  separate(
    col = sample_alias,
    into = c("donor", "timepoint"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  )

# Paired view: MPX and PNA values of the same sample connected by a line
p_fmc63_paired <- ggplot(
  fmc63_freq_plot,
  aes(platform, pct_fmc63, group = sample_alias, color = donor, fill = donor)
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(~ lineage + timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_donor) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_donor) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "% FMC63+ of lineage",
    title = "FMC63+ frequency within CD4 and CD8 T cells",
    caption = glue::glue(
      "One line per sample. Samples with >= {min_cells_lineage} cells of the lineage on both platforms."
    )
  )
p_fmc63_paired
fig7_save("fig7_supp_a_fmc63_frequency", p_fmc63_paired, width = 5, height = 4)

# Agreement view: MPX vs PNA per sample and lineage
fmc63_wide <- fmc63_freq_plot |>
  select(sample_alias, lineage, platform, pct_fmc63) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = platform, values_from = pct_fmc63)

p_fmc63_correlation <- ggplot(fmc63_wide, aes(MPX, PNA, fill = lineage)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_palette) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "MPX (% FMC63+)",
    y = "PNA (% FMC63+)",
    color = "Lineage",
    title = "FMC63+ frequency, MPX vs PNA",
    caption = "One point per sample and lineage. Dashed line: identity."
  )
p_fmc63_correlation
fig7_save(
  "fig7_supp_a_fmc63_frequency_correlation", # Manuscript: Supplementary Figure 8C
  p_fmc63_correlation,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)
```

### 8.1.2. Protein abundance

Compares protein abundance between MPX and PNA in CD4 and CD8 T cells (FMC63+ and FMC63-). MPX protein names are converted to the PNA names with the conversion table `data/PNA_proxiome_kit_v2_protein_list.csv` (`mpx_name` → `pna_name`), so only proteins present on both panels are compared and all plots use the PNA names.

The CLR values stored in the two objects cannot be compared directly: both were normalised with CLR over margin 2 (per cell, over all proteins of the panel), and the PNA and MPX panels contain different proteins, which gives every cell a different baseline. Two metrics computed from the raw counts of the shared proteins are therefore used instead:

- **`counts`**: `log10(mean raw count + 1)` per sample, cell type and protein. MPX and PNA counts differ in chemistry and depth, so this is used as a check of the agreement in protein ranking, not of absolute levels.
- **`clr_shared`**: CLR recomputed on the raw counts of the shared proteins only (same `NormalizeData(normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)` call as in the workflows). The CLR is per cell, so the choice of cells does not affect it; T cells are selected afterwards. This is the main comparison.

The scatter plots show the agreement in protein ranking (Spearman) and the heatmaps show the metric z-scored within each platform and cell type. Only samples with at least `min_cells_abundance` cells of the cell type on both platforms are included.

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_b_abundance_data

min_cells_abundance <- 15
t_cell_labels <- c(
  "CD4 T FMC63+",
  "CD4 T FMC63-",
  "CD8 T FMC63+",
  "CD8 T FMC63-"
)

# Conversion table: PNA protein names <-> MPX protein names
protein_map <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("pna_b1b2", "data", "PNA_proxiome_kit_v2_protein_list.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  select(pna_name, mpx_name) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ gsub("_", "-", .x))) # Seurat feature naming

mpx_features <- rownames(mpx_data[["mpxCells"]])
pna_features <- rownames(pna_data)

shared_markers <- protein_map |>
  filter(
    !is.na(mpx_name),
    mpx_name %in% mpx_features,
    pna_name %in% pna_features
  )

message(nrow(shared_markers), " proteins shared between MPX and PNA")
message(
  "PNA proteins without MPX counterpart: ",
  paste(setdiff(pna_features, shared_markers$pna_name), collapse = ", ")
)
message(
  "MPX features not in the conversion table: ",
  paste(setdiff(mpx_features, protein_map$mpx_name), collapse = ", ")
)

# Raw counts of the shared proteins (cells in columns), with rows renamed to
# the PNA protein name
get_counts <- function(obj, features, pna_names, assay) {
  m <- SeuratObject::LayerData(obj, assay = assay, layer = "counts")[features, ]
  rownames(m) <- pna_names
  m
}
counts_list <- list(
  MPX = get_counts(
    mpx_data,
    shared_markers$mpx_name,
    shared_markers$pna_name,
    assay = "mpxCells"
  ),
  PNA = get_counts(
    pna_data,
    shared_markers$pna_name,
    shared_markers$pna_name,
    assay = DefaultAssay(pna_data)
  )
)

# CLR recomputed on the shared proteins only (same call as in the workflows:
# margin = 2, i.e. per cell over the proteins that are present)
clr_list <- lapply(
  counts_list,
  Seurat::NormalizeData,
  normalization.method = "CLR",
  margin = 2
)

# Mean of a metric per sample x cell type x protein for the T cell labels
summarise_metric <- function(
  mat,
  meta,
  platform,
  metric,
  transform = identity
) {
  cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$cell_annotation %in% t_cell_labels]
  group <- paste(
    meta[cells, "sample_alias"],
    meta[cells, "cell_annotation"],
    sep = "||"
  )
  sums <- rowsum(as.matrix(Matrix::t(mat[, cells])), group)
  means <- sums / as.vector(table(group)[rownames(sums)])
  as_tibble(means, rownames = "group") |>
    pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "marker", values_to = "value") |>
    separate(
      group,
      into = c("sample_alias", "cell_annotation"),
      sep = "\\|\\|"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      value = transform(value),
      platform = platform,
      metric = metric
    )
}

meta_list <- list(MPX = mpx_data@meta.data, PNA = pna_data@meta.data)
log10p1 <- function(x) log10(x + 1)
abund <- bind_rows(
  summarise_metric(counts_list$MPX, meta_list$MPX, "MPX", "counts", log10p1),
  summarise_metric(counts_list$PNA, meta_list$PNA, "PNA", "counts", log10p1),
  summarise_metric(clr_list$MPX, meta_list$MPX, "MPX", "clr_shared"),
  summarise_metric(clr_list$PNA, meta_list$PNA, "PNA", "clr_shared")
)

metric_labels <- c(
  counts = "log10(mean count + 1)",
  clr_shared = "mean CLR (shared proteins)"
)

# Keep sample x cell type combinations with enough cells on both platforms
cell_counts <- cell_meta |>
  filter(cell_annotation %in% t_cell_labels) |>
  count(sample_alias, platform, cell_annotation, name = "n_cells") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = platform, values_from = n_cells, values_fill = 0L)
for (col in c("MPX", "PNA")) {
  if (!col %in% names(cell_counts)) cell_counts[[col]] <- 0L
}
cell_counts <- cell_counts |>
  filter(MPX >= min_cells_abundance, PNA >= min_cells_abundance)
abund <- abund |>
  semi_join(cell_counts, by = c("sample_alias", "cell_annotation"))

# Average over samples; z-score across proteins within platform, cell type and metric
abund_avg <- abund |>
  summarise(
    value = mean(value),
    n_samples = n_distinct(sample_alias),
    .by = c(metric, cell_annotation, marker, platform)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    z_value = as.numeric(scale(value)),
    .by = c(metric, cell_annotation, platform)
  )

# Number of samples retained per cell type and platform
abund_avg |>
  distinct(cell_annotation, platform, n_samples) |>
  arrange(cell_annotation, platform)

readr::write_csv(
  abund_avg,
  file.path(fig7_dir, "fig7_supp_b_abundance_summary.csv")
)
```

#### Agreement per cell type

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_b_abundance_correlation

# One scatter plot per metric: MPX vs PNA per protein, one panel per cell type
p_abundance_correlation <- list()
for (metric_select in names(metric_labels)) {
  abund_wide <- abund_avg |>
    filter(metric == metric_select) |>
    select(cell_annotation, marker, platform, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = platform, values_from = value) |>
    mutate(
      # Rank difference within each cell type, used to label outlier proteins
      rank_diff = abs(rank(MPX) - rank(PNA)),
      .by = cell_annotation
    )

  abund_cor <- abund_wide |>
    summarise(
      rho = cor(MPX, PNA, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
      n_markers = n(),
      .by = cell_annotation
    ) |>
    mutate(
      panel = glue::glue(
        "{cell_annotation}\nSpearman rho = {round(rho, 2)}, n = {n_markers} proteins"
      )
    )

  abund_wide <- abund_wide |>
    left_join(
      abund_cor |> select(cell_annotation, panel),
      by = "cell_annotation"
    )

  p <- ggplot(abund_wide, aes(MPX, PNA)) +
    # The shared-protein CLR is on a comparable scale, so show the identity line
    {
      if (metric_select == "clr_shared") {
        geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50")
      }
    } +
    geom_point(aes(color = cell_annotation), alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = abund_wide |> slice_max(rank_diff, n = 5, by = cell_annotation),
      aes(label = marker),
      size = 2.8,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_palette, guide = "none") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
    labs(
      x = paste("MPX", metric_labels[[metric_select]]),
      y = paste("PNA", metric_labels[[metric_select]]),
      title = "Protein abundance, MPX vs PNA",
      caption = glue::glue(
        "Metric: {metric_labels[[metric_select]]}, averaged over samples with >= {min_cells_abundance} cells on both platforms. ",
        "Labelled: the 5 proteins with the largest rank difference per cell type."
      )
    )
  print(p)
  p_abundance_correlation[[metric_select]] <- p
  fig7_save(
    paste0("fig7_supp_b_abundance_correlation_", metric_select),
    p,
    width = 9,
    height = 8
  )
}
```

```{r}
    # name = paste0(
    #   "Abundance\n(z-scored\n",
    #   metric_labels[[metric_select]],
    #   ")"
    # ),
    name = metric_select,
    col = abund_col_fun,
    cluster_rows = protein_clust,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    column_split = factor(col_meta$cell_annotation, levels = t_cell_labels),
    column_labels = col_meta$platform,
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    top_annotation = ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
      Platform = col_meta$platform,
      col = list(Platform = c(MPX = "#D6604D", PNA = "#2166AC")),
      show_annotation_name = FALSE
    ),
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 6),
    column_names_rot = 0,
    rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.3)
  )
  caption_text <- paste0(
    "Abundance (z-scored ",
    metric_labels[[metric_select]],
    ")"
  )
  p <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(ht_abundance) & labs(caption = caption_text)
  fig7_save(
    paste0("fig7_supp_b_abundance_heatmap_", metric_select),
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = max(6, 0.1 * nrow(abund_mat) + 2)
  )
}
```


### 8.1.3. Differential comparison

From the MPX data (tisa-cel) we performed differential comparisons between T1 and T0, and we can compare the significant hits from that analysis with out PNA tisa-cel T1 vs T0 comparison. Focus only on CD8 T FMC63+ cells. 

```{r}
# PNA: Read pseudobulk differential test results (abundance, clustering, colocalization)
dir_root <- here::here("pna_b1b2", "results_cleaned", "05_statistical_testing")

modes <- c("abundance", "clustering", "colocalization")
diff_res_tisacel_list <- lapply(
  modes,
  function(mode) {
    res_tbl <- readRDS(file.path(
      dir_root,
      mode,
      "pseudobulk",
      paste0("differential_", mode, "_analysis.rds")
    )) |>
      filter(
        target == "t1_tisa-cel",
        reference == "t0_tisa-cel",
        group == "CD8 T FMC63+"
      )
    res_tbl$mode <- mode
    res_tbl$platform <- "PNA"
    return(res_tbl)
  }
)
diff_res_tisacel_list <- setNames(diff_res_tisacel_list, nm = modes)

pna_daa_tisa_res <- diff_res_tisacel_list$abundance
pna_dca_tisa_res <- diff_res_tisacel_list$colocalization
```

```{r}
dir_root <- here::here("mpx_2", "results", "b1b2_t0t1", "revised_figs")
```

#### Name conversion and overlap tables

MPX protein names are converted to the PNA names with the conversion table (`mpx_name` → `pna_name`). Only exact matches are used: MPX markers without a match in the table (panel differences) are excluded and listed in the message of the chunk. The PNA results are restricted to the proteins on the MPX panel, and for colocalization to the marker pairs tested in both platforms (pairs are matched irrespective of marker order). Markers and pairs are classified as significant when adj p < 0.05 and the direction is the sign of the T1 - T0 difference.

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_c_mpx_pna_tables

sig_cutoff <- 0.05

# MPX -> PNA protein names, exact matches in the conversion table only
protein_map <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("pna_b1b2", "data", "PNA_proxiome_kit_v2_protein_list.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  select(pna_name, mpx_name) |>
  filter(!is.na(mpx_name), mpx_name != "") |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ gsub("_", "-", .x))) |>
  distinct(mpx_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
mpx_to_pna <- setNames(protein_map$pna_name, protein_map$mpx_name)

mpx_markers_all <- union(
  mpx_daa_tisa_res$marker,
  c(mpx_dca_tisa_res$marker_1, mpx_dca_tisa_res$marker_2)
)
dropped <- setdiff(mpx_markers_all, names(mpx_to_pna))
message(
  length(dropped),
  " MPX markers without an exact match in the name table (excluded): ",
  paste(sort(dropped), collapse = ", ")
)

pair_key <- function(m1, m2) paste(pmin(m1, m2), pmax(m1, m2), sep = "__")

mpx_daa <- mpx_daa_tisa_res |>
  mutate(marker = unname(mpx_to_pna[marker])) |>
  filter(!is.na(marker)) |>
  select(marker, diff_mpx = difference, padj_mpx = p_adj)
mpx_dca <- mpx_dca_tisa_res |>
  mutate(
    marker_1 = unname(mpx_to_pna[marker_1]),
    marker_2 = unname(mpx_to_pna[marker_2])
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(marker_1), !is.na(marker_2)) |>
  transmute(
    pair = pair_key(marker_1, marker_2),
    marker_1,
    marker_2,
    diff_mpx = difference,
    padj_mpx = p_adj
  )

# PNA: only proteins / pairs on the MPX panel and tested in both platforms
pna_daa <- pna_daa_tisa_res |>
  filter(marker %in% mpx_daa$marker) |>
  select(marker, diff_pna = difference, padj_pna = p_adj)
pna_dca <- pna_dca_tisa_res |>
  transmute(
    pair = pair_key(marker_1, marker_2),
    diff_pna = diff_median,
    padj_pna = p_adj
  ) |>
  filter(pair %in% mpx_dca$pair)

classify <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      sig_pna = padj_pna < sig_cutoff,
      sig_mpx = padj_mpx < sig_cutoff,
      dir_pna = ifelse(diff_pna > 0, "up", "down"),
      dir_mpx = ifelse(diff_mpx > 0, "up", "down"),
      category = case_when(
        sig_pna & sig_mpx & dir_pna == dir_mpx ~ "Both, same direction",
        sig_pna & sig_mpx ~ "Both, opposite direction",
        sig_pna ~ "PNA only",
        sig_mpx ~ "MPX only",
        .default = "Neither"
      ),
      category = factor(
        category,
        levels = c(
          "Both, same direction",
          "Both, opposite direction",
          "PNA only",
          "MPX only",
          "Neither"
        )
      ),
      # Only direction and significance are compared: rescale to [-1, 1] for plotting
      diff_pna_scaled = diff_pna / max(abs(diff_pna)),
      diff_mpx_scaled = diff_mpx / max(abs(diff_mpx))
    )
}
daa_cmp <- inner_join(pna_daa, mpx_daa, by = "marker") |> classify()
dca_cmp <- inner_join(pna_dca, mpx_dca, by = "pair") |> classify()

dir.create(
  file.path(fig7_dir, "supplement"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
readr::write_csv(
  daa_cmp,
  file.path(fig7_dir, "supplement", "fig7_supp_mpx_pna_daa_comparison.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  dca_cmp,
  file.path(fig7_dir, "supplement", "fig7_supp_mpx_pna_dca_comparison.csv")
)
```

#### Scatter plot of differences

Differences are rescaled per platform to [-1, 1] (divided by the largest absolute difference), since only direction and significance are compared. Labelled: markers / pairs significant in both platforms.

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_c_mpx_pna_scatter

scatter_cmp <- function(df, label_col, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(diff_mpx_scaled, diff_pna_scaled, color = category)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = filter(df, sig_pna & sig_mpx),
      aes(label = .data[[label_col]]),
      size = 2.6,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = category_colors, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "MPX difference (scaled to [-1, 1])",
      y = "PNA difference (scaled to [-1, 1])",
      title = title,
      subtitle = glue::glue(
        "Spearman rho = {round(cor(df$diff_mpx, df$diff_pna, method = 'spearman'), 2)}, n = {nrow(df)}"
      )
    )
}
p_scatter <- (scatter_cmp(daa_cmp, "marker", "Abundance") |
  scatter_cmp(dca_cmp, "pair", "Colocalization")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
p_scatter

fig7_save(
  "supplement/fig7_supp_mpx_pna_overlap_scatter", # Manuscript: Supplementary Figure 8D
  p_scatter,
  width = 11,
  height = 5.5
)
```

#### Overlap by direction (UpSet)

Sets of significant markers / pairs: PNA up, PNA down, MPX up and MPX down (up / down = higher / lower at T1). Each bar is an exclusive combination, so the overlaps in the same direction and in opposite directions can be read directly.

```{r}
#| label: fig7_supp_c_mpx_pna_upset

draw_upset <- function(df, id_col, title) {
  ids <- df[[id_col]]
  cm <- make_comb_mat(
    list(
      `PNA up` = ids[df$sig_pna & df$dir_pna == "up"],
      `PNA down` = ids[df$sig_pna & df$dir_pna == "down"],
      `MPX up` = ids[df$sig_mpx & df$dir_mpx == "up"],
      `MPX down` = ids[df$sig_mpx & df$dir_mpx == "down"]
    ),
    mode = "distinct"
  )
  draw(UpSet(
    cm,
    top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(cm, add_numbers = TRUE),
    right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(cm, add_numbers = TRUE),
    column_title = title
  ))
}

upset_inputs <- list(
  abundance = list(daa_cmp, "marker", "Abundance"),
  colocalization = list(dca_cmp, "pair", "Colocalization")
)
for (a in names(upset_inputs)) {
  x <- upset_inputs[[a]]
  f <- file.path(
    fig7_dir,
    "supplement",
    paste0("fig7_supp_mpx_pna_upset_", a)
  )
  png(paste0(f, ".png"), width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", res = png_res)
  draw_upset(x[[1]], x[[2]], x[[3]])
  dev.off()
  pdf(paste0(f, ".pdf"), width = 6, height = 4)
  draw_upset(x[[1]], x[[2]], x[[3]])
  dev.off()
  draw_upset(x[[1]], x[[2]], x[[3]]) # also shown in the report
}
```

## 8.3. Panel C: Cell annotation proportions

Cell annotation proportions (%) per donor, with t0 and t1 side by side. Donors with only a t1 sample (top row) are plotted separately from donors with paired t0 and t1 samples (bottom row), where alluvia connect the proportions of each cell annotation between timepoints. The underlying table is saved as `7c_celltype_frequency_table.csv`.

```{r}
library(ggalluvial)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig7_panel_c
cellcluster_freq <- pg_data@meta.data |>
  filter(timepoint %in% c("t0", "t1")) |>
  group_by(donor, timepoint, cell_annotation) |>
  summarize(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(fraction = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) |>
  mutate(pct = round(fraction, 3) * 100) |>
  mutate(cell_annotation = as.factor(cell_annotation)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Donors with both timepoints vs. donors with t1 only
  mutate(
    donor_group = if_else(
      n_distinct(timepoint) == 2,
      "paired",
      "t1_only"
    ),
    .by = donor
  )

#' Plot
plot_cell_proportions <- function(
  data,
  show_alluvium = TRUE,
  show_legend = TRUE
) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(y = pct, x = timepoint))
  if (show_alluvium) {
    p <- p +
      geom_alluvium(
        aes(alluvium = cell_annotation, fill = cell_annotation),
        alpha = .3,
        color = "black"
      )
  }
  p +
    geom_col(aes(fill = cell_annotation), width = .5, color = "black") +
    # free_x/space = "free_x" keeps bar widths comparable within a row
    facet_grid(~donor, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cell_type_palette_fmc) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)
    ) +
    labs(y = "Cell type proportion (%)", x = "Timepoint", fill = "Cell type") +
    cowplot::theme_minimal_hgrid() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none"
    )
}

p_t1_only <- cellcluster_freq |>
  filter(donor_group == "t1_only") |>
  plot_cell_proportions(show_alluvium = FALSE) +
  labs(subtitle = "Donors with t1 sample only")

p_paired <- cellcluster_freq |>
  filter(donor_group == "paired") |>
  plot_cell_proportions(show_alluvium = TRUE) +
  labs(subtitle = "Donors with paired t0 and t1 samples")

p <- (p_t1_only / p_paired) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Cell proportions across donors",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
  )

fig7_save("fig7c_pna_cell_proportions_sankey", p, width = 10, height = 8) # Manuscript: Main Figure 7D
```

#### Abundance vulcano plot

```{r}
#### Abundance volcano plot (T0)
p_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 0.25 # effect-size threshold; adjust to your abundance scale
n_labels <- 5 # most extreme markers labelled per direction

# up = higher in axi-cel (matches the scatter palette), down = higher in tisa-cel
volcano_cols <- c(up = "#A75FC3", down = "#e6b553", ns = "grey75")

plot_abundance_volcano <- function(cell_select, file_name) {
  volcano_dat <- diff_res_t0 |>
    filter(mode == "abundance", group == cell_select) |>
    mutate(
      neg_log10_p_adj = -log10(pmax(p_adj, 1e-300)),
      direction = case_when(
        p_adj < p_cutoff & difference >= lfc_cutoff ~ "up",
        p_adj < p_cutoff & difference <= -lfc_cutoff ~ "down",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      direction = factor(direction, levels = names(volcano_cols))
    )

  # Label the markers furthest out, ranked by effect size, per direction
  label_dat <- slice_max(
    volcano_dat |> filter(direction != "ns"),
    abs(difference),
    n = n_labels,
    by = direction
  )
  x_lim <- max(abs(volcano_dat$difference), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

  p <- ggplot(
    volcano_dat,
    aes(difference, neg_log10_p_adj, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      color = "grey60"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      color = "grey60"
    ) +
    # n.s. points first so significant points are drawn on top
    geom_point(
      data = \(d) filter(d, direction == "ns"),
      size = 1.4,
      alpha = 0.5,
      stroke = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = \(d) filter(d, direction != "ns"),
      size = 1.9,
      alpha = 0.9,
      stroke = 0
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_dat,
      aes(label = marker),
      size = 3,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      min.segment.length = 0,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      seed = 1,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = volcano_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.1))) +
    labs(
      x = "Abundance difference",
      y = expression(-log[10] ~ "(adj. p-value)"),
      title = paste0(cell_select, " cells (T0)"),
      caption = "Differential protein abundance, axi-cel vs tisa-cel (T0)"
    ) +
    theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      aspect.ratio = 1
    )

  # print(p)
  fig7_save(file_name, p, width = 3, height = 3)
  invisible(p)
}

p_t0_volcano_pos <- plot_abundance_volcano(
  "CD8 T FMC63+",
  "fig7e_t0_abundance_volcano_cd8_fmc63" # Manuscript: Main Figure 7F (left)
)
p_t0_volcano_neg <- plot_abundance_volcano(
  "CD8 T FMC63-",
  "fig7e_t0_abundance_volcano_cd8_fmc63_neg" # Manuscript: Main Figure 7F (right)
)
```

```{r}
p_t0_scatter <- ggplot(
  scatter_t0,
  aes(difference_clustering, difference_abundance, color = abundance_sig)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = scatter_t0 |> slice_max(extremeness, n = n_labels, by = group),
    aes(label = marker),
    size = 2.8,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#9c3c67", `FALSE` = "#3c779c"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "p_adj < 0.05", `FALSE` = "n.s."),
    name = "Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, strip.background = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    y = paste0(
      "Abundance difference (",
      t0_groups[1],
      " - ",
      t0_groups[2],
      ")"
    ),
    x = "Clustering difference (median)",
    title = "T0: axi-cel vs tisa-cel",
    caption = glue::glue(
      "Results based on pseudobulk limma model using the platelet cleaned-up T cell data.
      Only showing markers with significant (adj p < 0.05) results from the differential clustering test. 
      Labelled: the {n_labels} markers furthest from the origin per cell type."
    )
  )

fig7_save(
  "supplement/fig7d_t0_abundance_vs_clustering",
  p_t0_scatter,
  width = 8,
  height = 7
)
```

#### Box/swarm plot

Boxplot for selected results

```{r}
# Per-cell raw clustering scores: self-proximity (marker_1 == marker_2) of every
# cell. Built once, since the full proximity table is large
self_prox <- ProximityScores(
  pg_data_clean[["PNA"]],
  assay = "PNA",
  lazy = FALSE
) |>
  filter(marker_1 == marker_2) |>
  select(cell_id = component, marker = marker_1, log2_ratio)

cell_meta_plot <- pg_data_clean@meta.data |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  transmute(
    cell_id,
    sample_alias = as.character(sample_alias),
    condition = as.character(condition),
    group = as.character(cell_annotation),
    construct = sub("^t[01]_", "", condition)
  )

# One marker: raw clustering score per cell (left) and CLR abundance per cell
# (right), split by construct, one facet per cell type
plot_marker_beeswarm_cells <- function(
  marker,
  conditions = t0_groups, # e.g. c("t0_axi-cel", "t0_tisa-cel")
  cell_types = NULL, # NULL = all cell types
  title_prefix = "T0",
  point_size = 0.5,
  max_cells_per_group = 1000L # random subsample per construct and cell type; NULL = all
) {
  clr <- SeuratObject::FetchData(
    pg_data_clean,
    vars = marker,
    layer = "data"
  ) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
    rename(clr = all_of(marker))

  # Cells without a clustering score for this marker are not plotted there
  prep <- function(df, value) {
    df <- df |>
      inner_join(cell_meta_plot, by = "cell_id") |>
      filter(condition %in% conditions) |>
      mutate(
        construct = factor(construct, levels = c("tisa-cel", "axi-cel"))
      )
    if (!is.null(cell_types)) {
      df <- filter(df, group %in% cell_types)
    }
    if (!is.null(max_cells_per_group)) {
      df <- df |>
        slice_sample(n = max_cells_per_group, by = c(group, construct))
    }
    df
  }

  clust_df <- self_prox |>
    filter(marker == !!marker) |>
    prep()
  abund_df <- clr |> prep()
  if (nrow(abund_df) == 0) {
    stop("No cells for marker '", marker, "' in the selected conditions")
  }

  base_plot <- function(df, y, ylab) {
    ggplot(
      df,
      aes(construct, .data[[y]], fill = construct, color = construct)
    ) +
      ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
        size = point_size,
        alpha = 0.5,
        width = 0.4
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(
        width = 0.4,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        fill = NA,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~group, nrow = 1) +
      scale_color_manual(values = sample_annotation_colors$construct) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = sample_annotation_colors$construct) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10)
      ) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = ylab)
  }

  p_clust <- base_plot(
    clust_df,
    "log2_ratio",
    "Clustering score (log2 ratio)"
  ) +
    labs(subtitle = "Clustering")
  p_abund <- base_plot(abund_df, "clr", "Abundance (CLR)") +
    labs(subtitle = "Abundance")

  (p_clust | p_abund) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(title_prefix, ": ", marker),
      caption = glue::glue(
        "One point per cell",
        "{if (!is.null(max_cells_per_group)) paste0(' (random subsample of up to ', max_cells_per_group, ' cells per construct and cell type)') else ''}. ",
        "\nBox: median and IQR."
      )
    )
}
```

### Colocalization & abundance

#### Scatter plot
```{r}
coloc_groups <- t0_groups
n_labels_coloc <- 10L

# Abundance results for the contrast, one row per cell type and marker
abund_t0 <- diff_res_list$abundance |>
  filter(target == coloc_groups[1], reference == coloc_groups[2]) |>
  select(group, marker, difference, p_adj)

# Colocalization results (one row per marker pair), only significant pairs as
# for clustering
coloc_t0 <- diff_res_list$colocalization |>
  filter(
    target == coloc_groups[1],
    reference == coloc_groups[2],
    p_adj < 0.05
  ) |>
  transmute(
    group,
    marker_1,
    marker_2,
    pair = paste(marker_1, marker_2, sep = " - "),
    difference_coloc = diff_median
  )

# Attach the abundance result of each protein in the pair
scatter_coloc_t0 <- coloc_t0 |>
  left_join(
    abund_t0 |> rename(marker_1 = marker, diff_1 = difference, padj_1 = p_adj),
    by = c("group", "marker_1")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    abund_t0 |> rename(marker_2 = marker, diff_2 = difference, padj_2 = p_adj),
    by = c("group", "marker_2")
  ) |>
  # Pairs where a protein has no abundance result are not plotted
  filter(!is.na(diff_1), !is.na(diff_2)) |>
  mutate(
    # Combined abundance difference of the two proteins (mean; use diff_1 + diff_2
    # for the sum)
    difference_abundance = (diff_1 + diff_2) / 2,
    n_sig = (padj_1 < 0.05) + (padj_2 < 0.05),
    abundance_sig = factor(
      n_sig,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2),
      labels = c("Neither significant", "One significant", "Both significant")
    ),
    extremeness = sqrt(difference_coloc^2) # sqrt(difference_coloc^2 + difference_abundance^2)
  )

p_t0_coloc <- ggplot(
  scatter_coloc_t0,
  aes(difference_coloc, difference_abundance, color = abundance_sig)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = scatter_coloc_t0 |>
      slice_max(extremeness, n = n_labels_coloc, by = group),
    aes(label = pair),
    size = 2.8,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither significant" = "#3c779c",
      "One significant" = "#9b5373",
      "Both significant" = "#ad8295"
    ),
    name = "Abundance (adj p < 0.05)",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, strip.background = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    x = "Colocalization difference (median)",
    y = paste0(
      "Mean abundance difference of the pair (",
      coloc_groups[1],
      " - ",
      coloc_groups[2],
      ")"
    ),
    title = "T0: axi-cel vs tisa-cel",
    caption = glue::glue(
      "Results based on pseudobulk limma model using the platelet cleaned-up T cell data.
      Only showing marker pairs with significant (adj p < 0.05) differential colocalization.
      Colour: how many of the two proteins have a significant abundance change.
      Labelled: the {n_labels_coloc} pairs furthest from the origin per cell type."
    )
  )
p_t0_coloc

fig7_save(
  "supplement/fig7d_t0_abundance_vs_colocalization",
  p_t0_coloc,
  width = 8,
  height = 7
)
```

#### Box/swarm plot

```{r}
# cell_meta_plot is the same per-cell metadata table as for the clustering and
# abundance plot function (cell_id, condition, group, construct)

# One marker pair: raw colocalization score per cell (left) and CLR abundance of
# each of the two proteins (middle, right), split by construct, one facet per
# cell type
plot_pair_beeswarm_cells <- function(
  marker_1,
  marker_2,
  conditions = t0_groups, # e.g. c("t0_axi-cel", "t0_tisa-cel")
  cell_types = NULL, # NULL = all cell types
  title_prefix = "T0",
  point_size = 0.5,
  max_cells_per_group = 1000L # random subsample per construct and cell type; NULL = all
) {
  if (marker_1 == marker_2) {
    stop("Provide two different markers")
  }
  available_types <- unique(cell_meta_plot$group)
  if (!is.null(cell_types)) {
    unknown <- setdiff(cell_types, available_types)
    if (length(unknown) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Unknown cell type(s): ",
        paste(unknown, collapse = ", "),
        ". Available: ",
        paste(sort(available_types), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }
  missing_markers <- setdiff(c(marker_1, marker_2), rownames(pg_data_clean))
  if (length(missing_markers) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Marker(s) not in the object: ",
      paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Colocalization score per cell. The pair is stored in one order only, so
  # match both orders
  coloc <- ProximityScores(
    pg_data_clean[["PNA"]],
    assay = "PNA",
    lazy = FALSE
  ) |>
    filter(
      (marker_1 == !!marker_1 & marker_2 == !!marker_2) |
        (marker_1 == !!marker_2 & marker_2 == !!marker_1)
    ) |>
    select(cell_id = component, log2_ratio)
  if (nrow(coloc) == 0) {
    stop("No colocalization scores for the pair ", marker_1, " - ", marker_2)
  }

  clr <- SeuratObject::FetchData(
    pg_data_clean,
    vars = c(marker_1, marker_2),
    layer = "data"
  ) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id")
  # Fixed column names, so marker names with hyphens work in aes()
  names(clr)[match(c(marker_1, marker_2), names(clr))] <- c(
    "abund_1",
    "abund_2"
  )

  # Cells without a colocalization score are not plotted in the first panel
  prep <- function(df) {
    df <- df |>
      inner_join(cell_meta_plot, by = "cell_id") |>
      filter(condition %in% conditions) |>
      mutate(
        construct = factor(construct, levels = c("tisa-cel", "axi-cel"))
      )
    if (!is.null(cell_types)) {
      # Facets follow the order given in cell_types
      df <- filter(df, group %in% cell_types) |>
        mutate(group = factor(group, levels = cell_types))
    }
    if (!is.null(max_cells_per_group)) {
      df <- df |>
        slice_sample(n = max_cells_per_group, by = c(group, construct))
    }
    df
  }

  coloc_df <- prep(coloc)
  abund_df <- prep(clr)
  if (nrow(abund_df) == 0) {
    stop("No cells in the selected conditions / cell types")
  }

  base_plot <- function(df, y, ylab) {
    ggplot(
      df,
      aes(construct, .data[[y]], fill = construct, color = construct)
    ) +
      ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
        size = point_size,
        alpha = 0.5,
        width = 0.4
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(
        width = 0.4,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        fill = NA,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~group, nrow = 1) +
      scale_color_manual(values = sample_annotation_colors$construct) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = sample_annotation_colors$construct) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10)
      ) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = ylab)
  }

  p_coloc <- base_plot(
    coloc_df,
    "log2_ratio",
    "Colocalization score (log2 ratio)"
  ) +
    labs(subtitle = "Colocalization")
  p_abund_1 <- base_plot(abund_df, "abund_1", "Abundance (CLR)") +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("Abundance: ", marker_1))
  p_abund_2 <- base_plot(abund_df, "abund_2", "Abundance (CLR)") +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("Abundance: ", marker_2))

  (p_coloc | p_abund_1 | p_abund_2) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(title_prefix, ": ", marker_1, " - ", marker_2),
      caption = glue::glue(
        "{if (!is.null(cell_types)) paste0('Cell type(s): ', paste(cell_types, collapse = ', '), '. ') else ''}",
        "One point per cell",
        "{if (!is.null(max_cells_per_group)) paste0(' (random subsample of up to ', max_cells_per_group, ' cells per construct and cell type)') else ''}. ",
        "Box: median and IQR."
      )
    )
}
```

## 8.5. Panel E:  T1 Axi-cel vs tisa-cel

Same analyses as section 8.4, for the T1 comparison (`t1_axi-cel` vs `t1_tisa-cel`). The differential test results (`diff_res_list`) and the beeswarm plot functions (`plot_marker_beeswarm_cells()`, `plot_pair_beeswarm_cells()`) are defined in section 8.4, so run that section first.

### Clustering & abundance
```{r}
t1_groups <- c("t1_axi-cel", "t1_tisa-cel")
diff_res_t1 <- bind_rows(
  diff_res_list$abundance,
  diff_res_list$clustering |>
    mutate(marker = marker_1, difference = diff_median) |>
    filter(p_adj < 0.05) |>
    select(colnames(diff_res_list$abundance))
) |>
  filter(target == t1_groups[1], reference == t1_groups[2])
```


#### Abundance vulcano plot

```{r}
#### Abundance vulcano plot
p_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 0.25 # effect-size threshold; adjust to your abundance scale
n_labels <- 3 # most extreme markers labelled per direction

col_up <- "#A75FC3" # "#9c3c67" # higher in axi-cel (matches the scatter palette)
col_down <- "#e6b553" # "#3c779c" # higher in tisa-cel
col_ns <- "grey75"

volcano_t1 <- diff_res_t1 |>
  filter(mode == "abundance", group == "CD8 T FMC63+") |>
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p_adj = -log10(pmax(p_adj, 1e-300)),
    direction = case_when(
      p_adj < p_cutoff & difference >= lfc_cutoff ~ "up",
      p_adj < p_cutoff & difference <= -lfc_cutoff ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("up", "down", "ns"))
  )

# Label the markers furthest out, ranked by effect size, per direction
label_dat <- volcano_t1 |>
  # filter(direction != "ns") |>
  slice_max(abs(difference), n = n_labels, by = direction)

n_up <- sum(volcano_t1$direction == "up")
n_down <- sum(volcano_t1$direction == "down")
x_lim <- max(abs(volcano_t1$difference), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

p_t1_volcano <- ggplot(
  volcano_t1,
  aes(difference, neg_log10_p_adj, color = direction)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    color = "grey60"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    color = "grey60"
  ) +
  # n.s. points first so significant points are drawn on top
  geom_point(
    data = \(d) filter(d, direction == "ns"),
    size = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.5,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = \(d) filter(d, direction != "ns"),
    size = 1.9,
    alpha = 0.9,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_dat,
    aes(label = marker),
    size = 3,
    # fontface = "italic",
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(up = col_up, down = col_down, ns = col_ns),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    x = "Abundance difference",
    y = expression(-log[10] ~ "(adj. p-value)"),
    title = "CD8 T FMC63+ cells (T1)",
    caption = "Differential protein abundance, axi-cel vs tisa-cel (T1)"
  ) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30", size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
p_t1_volcano

fig7_save(
  "fig7e_t1_abundance_volcano_cd8_fmc63",
  p_t1_volcano,
  width = 3,
  height = 3
)
```

```{r}
n_labels <- 3 # most extreme markers labelled per direction

col_up <- "#A75FC3" # "#9c3c67" # higher in axi-cel (matches the scatter palette)
col_down <- "#e6b553" # "#3c779c" # higher in tisa-cel
col_ns <- "grey75"

volcano_t1 <- diff_res_t1 |>
  filter(mode == "abundance", group == cell_select) |>
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p_adj = -log10(pmax(p_adj, 1e-300)),
    direction = case_when(
      p_adj < p_cutoff & difference >= lfc_cutoff ~ "up",
      p_adj < p_cutoff & difference <= -lfc_cutoff ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("up", "down", "ns"))
  )

# Label the markers furthest out, ranked by effect size, per direction
label_dat <- volcano_t1 |>
  # filter(direction != "ns") |>
  slice_max(abs(difference), n = n_labels, by = direction)

n_up <- sum(volcano_t1$direction == "up")
n_down <- sum(volcano_t1$direction == "down")
x_lim <- max(abs(volcano_t1$difference), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

p_t1_volcano <- ggplot(
  volcano_t1,
  aes(difference, neg_log10_p_adj, color = direction)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    color = "grey60"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    color = "grey60"
  ) +
  # n.s. points first so significant points are drawn on top
  geom_point(
    data = \(d) filter(d, direction == "ns"),
    size = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.5,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = \(d) filter(d, direction != "ns"),
    size = 1.9,
    alpha = 0.9,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_dat,
    aes(label = marker),
    size = 3,
    # fontface = "italic",
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(up = col_up, down = col_down, ns = col_ns),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    x = "Abundance difference",
    y = expression(-log[10] ~ "(adj. p-value)"),
    title = paste0(cell_select, " cells (T1)"),
    caption = "Differential protein abundance, axi-cel vs tisa-cel (T1)"
  ) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30", size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
p_t1_volcano

fig7_save(
  "fig7e_t1_abundance_volcano_cd8_fmc63_neg",
  p_t1_volcano,
  width = 3,
  height = 3
)
```

```{r}
coloc_groups <- t1_groups
n_labels_coloc <- 10L

# Abundance results for the contrast, one row per cell type and marker
abund_t1 <- diff_res_list$abundance |>
  filter(target == coloc_groups[1], reference == coloc_groups[2]) |>
  select(group, marker, difference, p_adj)

# Colocalization results (one row per marker pair), only significant pairs as
# for clustering
coloc_t1 <- diff_res_list$colocalization |>
  filter(
    target == coloc_groups[1],
    reference == coloc_groups[2],
    p_adj < 0.05
  ) |>
  transmute(
    group,
    marker_1,
    marker_2,
    pair = paste(marker_1, marker_2, sep = " - "),
    difference_coloc = diff_median
  )

# Attach the abundance result of each protein in the pair
scatter_coloc_t1 <- coloc_t1 |>
  left_join(
    abund_t1 |> rename(marker_1 = marker, diff_1 = difference, padj_1 = p_adj),
    by = c("group", "marker_1")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    abund_t1 |> rename(marker_2 = marker, diff_2 = difference, padj_2 = p_adj),
    by = c("group", "marker_2")
  ) |>
  # Pairs where a protein has no abundance result are not plotted
  filter(!is.na(diff_1), !is.na(diff_2)) |>
  mutate(
    # Combined abundance difference of the two proteins (mean; use diff_1 + diff_2
    # for the sum)
    difference_abundance = (diff_1 + diff_2) / 2,
    n_sig = (padj_1 < 0.05) + (padj_2 < 0.05),
    abundance_sig = factor(
      n_sig,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2),
```

#### Heatmap

```{r}
# Cell type shown: {heatmap_cell_type} only.
# Colocalization difference ({coloc_groups[1]} - {coloc_groups[2]}), marker pairs with adj p < 0.05.
# Row annotation: abundance change of the two proteins in {heatmap_cell_type}.
heatmap_cell_type <- "CD8 T FMC63+"
sig_levels <- c("Neither significant", "One significant", "Both significant")

# Significant colocalization pairs in the selected cell type, ordered by
# difference so the heatmap reads from most negative to most positive
heat_df <- scatter_coloc_t1 |>
  filter(group == heatmap_cell_type) |>
  filter(n_sig == 0) |> # filter to only show pairs with no significant abundance change
  arrange(difference_coloc)

if (nrow(heat_df) == 0) {
  message("No significant colocalization pairs to plot for ", heatmap_cell_type)
} else {
  heatmap_height <- max(6, 0.12 * nrow(heat_df) + 2)

  # Matrix: pairs x 1 column, colocalization difference (median)
  coloc_mat <- matrix(
    heat_df$difference_coloc,
    ncol = 1,
    dimnames = list(heat_df$pair, heatmap_cell_type)
  )

  sig_colors <- c(
    "Neither significant" = "grey85",
    "One significant" = "#3c779c",
    "Both significant" = "#9c3c67"
  )

  heat_limit_coloc <- 0.7
  coloc_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
    seq(
      -heat_limit_coloc,
      heat_limit_coloc,
      length.out = length(gradient_palette)
    ),
    gradient_palette
  )

  row_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
    Abundance = heat_df$abundance_sig,
    col = list(Abundance = sig_colors),
    annotation_name_side = "top",
    annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    gp = grid::gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.3),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      Abundance = list(title = "Abundance (adj p < 0.05)", at = sig_levels)
    )
  )

  ht_coloc <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    coloc_mat,
    name = "Colocalization\ndifference\n(median)",
    col = coloc_col_fun,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    # row_split = heat_df$abundance_sig,
    # cluster_row_slices = FALSE, # keep the slice order set by the factor levels
    # right_annotation = row_anno,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    # column_names_rot = 0,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    width = unit(5, "mm"),
    rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.3)
  )

  # Export figure
  png(
    paste0(fig7_dir, "/supplement/fig7e_t1_colocalization_heatmap", ".png"),
    width = 4,
    height = heatmap_height,
    units = "in",
    res = png_res
  )
  draw(
    ht_coloc,
    column_title = paste0("T1: axi-cel vs tisa-cel,\n", heatmap_cell_type),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  )
  dev.off()

  pdf(
    paste0(fig7_dir, "/supplement/fig7e_t1_colocalization_heatmap", ".pdf"),
    width = 4,
    height = heatmap_height
  )
  draw(
    ht_coloc,
    column_title = paste0("T1: axi-cel vs tisa-cel,\n", heatmap_cell_type),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  )
  dev.off()
}
```

### Heatmap of FMC63 colocalization

```{r}
#| label: fig7_panel_f

```

```{r}
#| label: fmc63_colocalization_top_partners

# Define params
marker_of_interest <- "FMC63"
grouping_column <- "sample_alias"
max_heatmap_markers <- 50
marker_min_joincount <- 5
min_pct_detected <- 0.25
clr_cutoff <- 0.5 # same criterion as markers_to_test
min_cells_per_sample <- 15L # same as markers_to_test
sample_order <- metadata |> arrange(timepoint) |> pull(sample_alias)
# Heatmap row annotations (sample_annotation, sample_annotation_colors) are
# defined in common_setup.R

source(here::here("pna_b1b2", "modules", "marker_selection_functions.R"))

cell_types <- unique(pg_data[[]]$cell_annotation)
cell_types <- cell_types[!is.na(cell_types)]
cell_types <- cell_types[grep("FMC63\\+", cell_types)]
cell_types <- cell_types[grep("CD8", cell_types)]

# Mean CLR per sample x cell type x marker. Samples with fewer than
# min_cells_per_sample cells of the cell type are already dropped here.
clr_sample_means <- compute_sample_clr_means(
  pg_data_clean,
  cell_types = cell_types,
  sample_col = grouping_column,
  min_cells_per_sample = min_cells_per_sample
)
clr_marker_summary <- summarise_marker_clr(clr_sample_means, clr_cutoff)

# Cluster markers (columns of `mat`) while tolerating NA. dist() pro-rates over
# the samples where both markers are measured; pairs with no overlap get the
# largest finite distance so hclust() can run. Returns FALSE (no clustering)
# if fewer than 2 columns or no finite distance at all.
cluster_cols_na <- function(mat) {
  if (ncol(mat) < 2) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  d <- dist(t(mat))
  finite_d <- is.finite(d)
  if (!any(finite_d)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  d[!finite_d] <- max(d[finite_d])
  hclust(d)
}

for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  # Extract proximity data
  proximity_data <- ProximityScores(
    pg_data_clean,
    lazy = FALSE,
    meta_data_columns = c(grouping_column, "cell_annotation")
  ) |>
    filter(cell_annotation == cell_type) |>
    filter(marker_1 == marker_of_interest | marker_2 == marker_of_interest) |>
    filter(marker_1 != marker_2) |>
    # Drop sparsely observed pairs: join_count is the number of edges between
    # the two markers in a cell's graph, not a marker abundance.
    filter(join_count > marker_min_joincount) |>
    collect()

  # Summarize scores
  summary_proximity_data <- SummarizeProximityScores(
    proximity_data,
    group_vars = c(grouping_column, "cell_annotation")
  ) |>
    filter(pct_detected >= min_pct_detected)
  rm(proximity_data)
  gc()

  # Identify top colocalization proteins
  plot_data <- summary_proximity_data |>
    # filter(marker_1 == marker_of_interest | marker_2 == marker_of_interest) |>
    mutate(
      marker = ifelse(marker_1 != marker_of_interest, marker_1, marker_2)
    ) |>
    group_by(cell_annotation, !!sym(grouping_column), marker) |>
    summarise(
      mean_log2_ratio = mean(mean_log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_detected = mean(pct_detected, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_log2_ratio))

  # Markers passing the CLR criterion in this cell type, and the samples that
  # were eligible for that test (>= min_cells_per_sample cells)
  passing_markers <- clr_marker_summary |>
    filter(group == cell_type, pass) |>
    pull(marker)
  included_samples <- clr_sample_means |>
    filter(group == cell_type) |>
    pull(sample) |>
    unique()

  plot_data <- plot_data |>
    filter(
      marker %in% passing_markers,
      .data[[grouping_column]] %in% included_samples
    )

  message(
    cell_type,
    ": ",
    n_distinct(plot_data$marker),
    " partner markers pass CLR > ",
    clr_cutoff,
    " in all ",
    length(included_samples),
    " samples"
  )

  plot_data <-
    plot_data |>
    select(marker, mean_log2_ratio, !!sym(grouping_column)) |>
    # Pivot to wide format for heatmap.
    # NOTE: a marker/sample combination removed upstream by min_pct_detected or
    # marker_min_joincount is left as NA ("not measured"), drawn grey in the
    # heatmap, and ignored (na.rm) when ranking the top partners below.
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = !!sym(grouping_column),
      values_from = mean_log2_ratio
    ) |>
    column_to_rownames("marker") |>
    as.matrix()

  # Filter to keep top colocalization partners by avg across donors
  markers_keep <- plot_data |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(avg = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    arrange(desc(abs(avg))) |>
    slice_head(n = max_heatmap_markers) |>
    rownames()

  # Plot heatmap
  effect_quantiles <- quantile(
    plot_data[markers_keep, ],
    probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  max_abs_effect <- max(abs(effect_quantiles))
  breaks_range <- seq(-max_abs_effect, max_abs_effect, length.out = 101)
  sample_order <- intersect(sample_order, colnames(plot_data))

  hm_mat <- t(plot_data[markers_keep, sample_order])

  hm_coloc <-
    hm_mat |>
    pheatmap(
      color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
      breaks = breaks_range,
      na_col = "grey85",
      border_color = "white",
      cellwidth = 8,
      cellheight = 8,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = cluster_cols_na(hm_mat),
      treeheight_col = 10,
      # pheatmap draws annotation columns right to left, so reverse them to read
      # timepoint, status, construct from left to right
      annotation_row = sample_annotation[
        sample_order,
        rev(sample_annotation_cols),
        drop = FALSE
      ],
      annotation_colors = sample_annotation_colors,
      heatmap_legend_param = list(
        title = "FMC63 colocalization\n(mean log2 ratio)"
      ),
      main = paste0("FMC63 colocalization in ", cell_type),
      fontsize = 8
    ) |>
    as.ggplot()
  fig7_save(
    glue::glue(
      "supplement/fig7f_{cell_type}_top_colocalizing_protein_colocalization_heatmap_donor" # Manuscript: Supplementary Figure 10C
    ),
    plot = hm_coloc,
    width = 16,
    height = 4
  )

  # Same markers averaged across samples per timepoint x construct. NA (not
  # measured) sample values are ignored; n_samples still counts all samples.
  group_levels_timepoint <- names(sample_annotation_colors$timepoint)
  group_levels_construct <- names(sample_annotation_colors$construct)

  group_summary <- plot_data[markers_keep, sample_order, drop = FALSE] |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("marker") |>
    pivot_longer(
      -marker,
      names_to = "sample_alias",
      values_to = "mean_log2_ratio"
    ) |>
    left_join(
      sample_annotation |>
        rownames_to_column("sample_alias") |>
        select(sample_alias, timepoint, construct),
      by = "sample_alias"
    ) |>
    group_by(timepoint, construct, marker) |>
    summarise(
      mean_log2_ratio = if (all(is.na(mean_log2_ratio))) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        mean(mean_log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      n_samples = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = group_levels_timepoint),
      construct = factor(construct, levels = group_levels_construct),
      group = paste(timepoint, construct, sep = "_")
    ) |>
    # Construct first, then timepoint, so each construct's t0 -> t1 rows are
    # adjacent
    arrange(construct, timepoint, marker)

  group_output_basename <- glue::glue(
    "fig7f_{cell_type}_top_colocalizing_protein_colocalization_heatmap_timepoint_construct" # Manuscript: Main Figure 7E
  )

  group_info <- group_summary |>
    distinct(group, timepoint, construct, n_samples) |>
    arrange(timepoint)
  group_mat <- group_summary |>
    select(group, marker, mean_log2_ratio) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = mean_log2_ratio) |>
    column_to_rownames("group") |>
    as.matrix()
  group_mat <- group_mat[group_info$group, markers_keep, drop = FALSE]

  group_annotation <- group_info |>
    select(group, construct, timepoint) |>
    mutate(across(c(construct, timepoint), as.character)) |>
    column_to_rownames("group")

  # Own colour scale: averaging shrinks the range relative to the per-sample map
  group_quantiles <- quantile(group_mat, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  group_max_abs <- max(abs(group_quantiles))
  if (!is.finite(group_max_abs) || group_max_abs == 0) {
    group_max_abs <- 1
  }
  group_breaks <- seq(-group_max_abs, group_max_abs, length.out = 101)

  hm_coloc_group <-
    group_mat |>
    pheatmap(
      color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
      breaks = group_breaks,
      na_col = "grey85",
      border_color = "white",
      cellwidth = 8,
      cellheight = 8,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = cluster_cols_na(group_mat),
      treeheight_col = 10,
      labels_row = paste0(
        group_info$group,
        " (n = ",
        group_info$n_samples,
        ")"
      ),
      # Reversed order (see above): reads timepoint, construct left to right
      annotation_row = group_annotation,
      annotation_colors = sample_annotation_colors[c("timepoint", "construct")],
      heatmap_legend_param = list(
        title = "FMC63 colocalization\n(mean log2 ratio,\nmean of samples)"
      ),
      main = paste0(
        "FMC63 colocalization in ",
        cell_type,
        " (mean per timepoint x construct)"
      ),
      fontsize = 8
    ) |>
    as.ggplot()
  fig7_save(
    glue::glue(
      "supplement/{group_output_basename}"
    ),
    plot = hm_coloc_group,
    width = 16,
    height = 4
  )
}
```


### Bubble plot of FMC63 colocalization

#### T0

```{r}
source(here::here("pna_b1b2", "modules", "marker_selection_functions.R"))
tp_select <- "t0"
coloc_cell_type <- "CD8 T FMC63+"
coloc_min_cells <- 15L
coloc_min_mean_clr <- 0.5

# Samples at the selected timepoint (from metadata; no reliance on alias naming)
tp_samples <- metadata |>
  filter(timepoint == tp_select) |>
  pull(sample_alias)

# Mean log2 ratio per sample, restricted to the cell type and timepoint
colocscores_summarized <- ProximityScores(
  pg_data_clean,
  meta_data_columns = c("sample_alias", "donor", "cell_annotation", "timepoint")
) |>
  filter(cell_annotation == coloc_cell_type, timepoint == tp_select) |>
  SummarizeProximityScores(
    group_vars = c("sample_alias", "donor", "cell_annotation", "timepoint"),
    proximity_metric = "log2_ratio",
    summary_stat = "mean",
    include_missing_obs = TRUE
  )

# Marker pre-filtering (as in the FMC63 top partners heatmaps), selected
# timepoint only: keep markers with mean CLR > coloc_min_mean_clr in every
# sample with >= coloc_min_cells cells of the cell type
clr_means_tp <- compute_sample_clr_means(
  pg_data_clean,
  cell_types = coloc_cell_type,
  sample_col = "sample_alias",
  min_cells_per_sample = coloc_min_cells
) |>
  filter(sample %in% tp_samples)

passing_markers <- summarise_marker_clr(clr_means_tp, coloc_min_mean_clr) |>
  filter(pass) |>
  pull(marker)
included_samples <- unique(clr_means_tp$sample)

# Marker x marker heatmap data: mean over included donors
coloc_dat_tp <- colocscores_summarized |>
  filter(
    sample_alias %in% included_samples,
    marker_1 %in% passing_markers,
    marker_2 %in% passing_markers
  ) |>
  select(donor, marker_1, marker_2, mean_log2_ratio) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = donor, values_from = mean_log2_ratio) |>
  mutate(
    mean_coloc_score = rowMeans(across(-c(marker_1, marker_2)), na.rm = TRUE),
    size_constant = 1
  )

p_ref <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
  coloc_dat_tp,
  value_col = "mean_coloc_score",
  size_col = "size_constant",
  type = "dots",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  size_range = c(1, 4.5)
)
m_order <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(p_ref)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x$get_labels()
```
```{r}
#| label: fig7x-fmc63-coloc-bubbleplot_t0
# Construct per sample, from metadata
construct_lookup <- metadata |>
  distinct(sample_alias, construct)

fmc_coloc_data <- colocscores_summarized |>
  filter(
    sample_alias %in% included_samples,
    marker_1 == "FMC63" | marker_2 == "FMC63"
  ) |>
  left_join(construct_lookup, by = "sample_alias") |>
  mutate(
    marker = ifelse(marker_1 == "FMC63", marker_2, marker_1),
    patient = paste0(gsub("donor", "Donor ", donor), " (", construct, ")")
  ) |>
  filter(marker %in% c("FMC63", m_order)) |>
  select(marker, patient, mean_log2_ratio)

fmc_coloc_per_donor_plot <- DifferentialBubblePlot(
  data = fmc_coloc_data,
  color_palette = colors,
  has_pvalues = FALSE,
  effect_cutoff = 0,
  # color_range = c(-1, 1),
  color_range = c(-0.8, 0.8),
  group_var = "patient",
  size_range = 5,
  effect_col = "mean_log2_ratio"
) +
  labs(
    fill = "Mean\ncolocalization\n(log2 ratio)",
    title = paste0(
      "FMC63 colocalization in FMC63+ CD8+ T (",
      toupper(tp_select),
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "cm")
  )

fig7_save(
  "supplement/fig7f_t0_fmc63_coloc_per_donor", # Manuscript: Supplementary Figure 10A
  fmc_coloc_per_donor_plot,
  width = 13,
  height = 3
)
```

## 8.7. Panel G: Cell visualization

TODO: describe what panel G shows and which module or data it is based on.

This needs to be done on the non-cleaned data to start with. For cleaned data, layouts are stored separately.


```{r}
#| label: cell_viz_parameters
tp_select <- "t1"
cell_type_of_interest <- "CD8 T FMC63+" # one value from `cell_annotation`
markers_to_viz <- c("FMC63", "CD48", "CD52", "CD55", "CD59", "CD45") # markers to render on the graph
n_cells <- 4 # cells to show in the 2D grid
```

```{r}
#| label: cell_viz_select_cells

# check coloc scores
colocscores_cell_viz <- ProximityScores(
  pg_data,
  lazy = TRUE,
  meta_data_columns = c(
    "sample_alias",
    "donor",
    "construct",
    "cell_annotation",
    "timepoint"
  )
) |>
  filter(cell_annotation == cell_type_of_interest, timepoint == tp_select) |>
  filter(marker_1 %in% markers_to_viz, marker_2 %in% markers_to_viz) |>
  filter(join_count > 5)

# select cells
cells_of_interest_axi <- colocscores_cell_viz |>
  filter(marker_1 == "CD48", marker_2 == "CD52") |>
  filter(log2_ratio > 2, log2_ratio < 2.5) |>
  group_by(sample_alias) |>
  slice_max(order_by = desc(log2_ratio), n = 1) |>
  pull(component)

cells_of_interest_tisa <- colocscores_cell_viz |>
  filter(marker_1 == "CD48", marker_2 == "CD52") |>
  filter(log2_ratio > 0.5, log2_ratio < 1) |>
  group_by(sample_alias) |>
  slice_max(order_by = desc(log2_ratio), n = 1) |>
  pull(component)

cells_of_interest <- c(cells_of_interest_axi, cells_of_interest_tisa)

if (length(cells_of_interest) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No cells found for '",
    cell_type_of_interest,
    "'. Check the values in `cell_annotation`."
  )
}

colocscores_cell_viz |>
  filter(component %in% cells_of_interest) |>
  select(component, sample_alias, donor, construct, timepoint) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(construct, donor)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell_viz_layout
pg_data <- LoadCellGraphs(
  pg_data,
  cells = cells_of_interest,
  add_layouts = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

pg_data <- ComputeLayout(pg_data, layout_method = "cpmds") # for the 3D view
```

```{r}
#| label: cell_viz_2d
p_2d <- Plot2DGraphM(
  pg_data,
  cells = cells_of_interest,
  markers = markers_to_viz,
  layout_method = "cpmds_3d"
)
p_2d

fig7_save(
  "fig7g_2d_graph_selected_prot_t_fmc_layout_cpmds_3d", # Manuscript: Supplementary Figure 10D
  p_2d,
  width = length(cells_of_interest) * 3 + 1,
  height = length(markers_to_viz) * 3 + 0.5
)
```
